title: How Many Times Has Ye Been Sued Over Samples? Here’s Every Single Lawsuit He’s Faced.
summary: Kanye has been sued over and over for allegedly borrowing material without paying for it. Billboard is keeping track of the lawsuits and explaining each one.
contentText:
Ye (formerly Kanye West ) has been sued many, many times for allegedly sampling copyrighted music without permission. Here’s a breakdown of every lawsuit he’s faced, what songs it involved, and how each case ended.

Over the course of his prolific career, federal court records show the rapper has been sued at least 20 times over claims of illegal sampling (the use of a copyrighted sound recording) or interpolating (the use of a copyrighted composition) in songs, including a whopping 15 such cases since 2019 alone.

And that’s not counting cases where others have been sued over his songs, like a case filed in 2012 against Roc-A-Fella Records, or a recent case against UMG filed by members of prog rock band King Crimson, nor allegations that didn’t result in a lawsuit, like Ozzy Osbourne’s accusations in 2024.

Like most sampling lawsuits, very few of those cases against Ye have gone the distance, and the vast majority have ended in private settlements. But one of them went to trial in May 2026 , resulting in a rare opportunity to hear the artist testify on the witness stand about his approach to sampling — and why he’s been sued so many times.

“I pride myself on giving people what they deserve,” Ye told the jurors, referring to credit and royalties. “I feel like a lot of people try to take advantage of me.” A week later, a jury issued a verdict that Ye was liable for copyright infringement and must pay a six-figure damages total.
